fieldNotes.truckGate: 3832 S Military Hwy is a multi-tenant industrial address shared by several trucking/logistics firms (M&J Transport, Sheridan Logistics, CDS Trucking, SalSon-Norfolk). The complex is accessed by an open dirt/gravel driveway with no barrier arm or gate visible in 2026-04 Street View — entrance is uncontrolled at the road, so truckGate is false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible. The 3832 address marker is just a wooden sign with a bank of mailboxes at the open driveway entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No dock-door warehouse on the SalSon portion — the site is an open container/trailer/chassis storage yard with only small office/support structures.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Sprawling unpaved gravel yard with rows of hundreds of trailers and intermodal containers; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-tenant complex — several distinct yards and small buildings under the shared 3832 S Military Hwy address; SalSon occupies one portion.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box covers the full multi-tenant complex (~16 acres); SalSon's tenant footprint is a subset of that.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium — SalSon's exact sub-parcel within the multi-tenant 3832 S Military Hwy complex could not be isolated; the audit characterizes the whole shared container/trailer yard.
